newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco eyes cut for industrial users.
newsitem.headline: Meralco eyes cut for industrial users.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco) said it planned to cut power rates for industrial users to lure back companies that had set up their own power generation facilities.
Meralco president Manuel Lopez told reporters it would cut its rate by 14 to 16 centavos per kilowatt hour as early as June if the Energy Regulatory Board approved its petition.
The current tariff imposed on industrial users is 3.25 pesos per kilowatthour.
Power sales to the industrial sector fell by 1.1 percent in 1996, compared with 5.6 percent growth in 1995.
